title: Dhanteras Outfit Ideas: What to Wear on Dhanteras 2026 for Women
excerpt: Dhanteras is on 6 November 2026. Here are easy outfit ideas for shopping, evening puja and family visits, with colours and fabrics that feel festive.
body:
On Dhanteras, wear something festive but practical: a comfortable kurta set for daytime shopping and an Anarkali or embroidered suit with a touch of gold for the evening puja. Dhanteras falls on Friday, 6 November 2026, opening the five days of Diwali, so it is the perfect day to wear your first new outfit of the season.

## Why Dhanteras deserves its own outfit

Dhanteras is the day many families buy gold, silver or a new utensil, and light the first diya of Diwali in the evening for Lakshmi and Dhanvantari. It is also the day the house starts to feel like a festival.

That means two moods in one day. During the day you may be running errands, visiting a jeweller or an Indian store, and cleaning or decorating at home. In the evening there is a small puja and often a family dinner. Your outfit plan should cover both, either with one versatile look or a quick change.

## Daytime Dhanteras: easy and bright

If you live in the USA, UK or Canada, Dhanteras is a regular working Friday. A short kurti or tunic over jeans is the easiest way to carry the festival into your day without looking overdressed at work.

Yellow is a lovely Dhanteras colour, linked with prosperity and the warmth of gold. The [Yellow Embroidered Cotton Tunic Top with Black Floral Yoke](/products/yellow-black-embroidered-cotton-tunic-top/) works with blue denim and white sneakers in the morning, then with gold jhumkas and juttis by evening.

For a full set, a light cotton or kota doria kurta with straight pants is breathable and polished. The [Navy Blue Kota Doria Embroidered Kurta Pant Dupatta Set](/products/navy-blue-kota-doria-embroidered-kurta-pant-dupatta-set/) is light enough for a busy day and still looks put together when guests drop in.

## Evening puja: add shine and flare

When the diya is lit, it is time to step up. Dhanteras evening is about inviting prosperity, so a little gold detailing feels just right. Gota patti, zari borders or sequin work all catch the diya light beautifully.

An Anarkali is a classic choice because the flare looks graceful when you stand for the aarti and when you sit down for dinner. The [Royal Blue Georgette Anarkali Suit Set with Gota Lace Dupatta](/products/royal-blue-georgette-anarkali-suit-gota-handwork-dupatta/) is a rich jewel tone that looks striking with gold jewellery and photographs well at night.

If you prefer softer shades, the [Sage Green Taffeta Silk Gota Work Anarkali Suit Set](/products/sage-green-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-sequin-organza-dupatta/) pairs a muted green with a sequin organza dupatta, festive without being loud.

You can see more evening options in our [Anarkali suits](/anarkali-suits-online-usa-uk/) collection.

## Colour guide for Dhanteras

| Colour | What it suggests | How to style it |
|---|---|---|
| Yellow and mustard | Gold, prosperity, warmth | Gold earrings, white or ivory dupatta |
| Royal blue | Rich and regal | Gold jewellery, nude or gold juttis |
| Green and sage | New beginnings, growth | Pearl or kundan earrings |
| Red and maroon | Classic auspicious shades | Keep jewellery simple and bold |
| Pink and peach | Joyful and soft | Rose-gold or silver jewellery |

Wear what makes you feel lucky. Many women keep a favourite colour just for Dhanteras every year.

## Pairing tips that make the look

- **Jewellery:** this is the day for gold. A pair of jhumkas or chandbalis is enough with an embroidered neckline. If the kurta is plain, add a layered necklace.
- **Bangles:** a stack of glass or metal bangles adds a festive sound when you ring the puja bell.
- **Dupatta:** drape it on one shoulder for shopping and pin it neatly on both shoulders for the puja.
- **Shoes:** embellished juttis or block heels. If you are shopping on foot, carry juttis and change later.
- **Outer layer:** abroad, early November can be cold. A plain long cardigan or a camel coat over a kurta set looks elegant and keeps the outfit visible.

## Plan your Diwali week in one go

Dhanteras starts a run of festival days: Diwali on 8 November and Bhai Dooj on 10 November. If you plan a few outfits together, you can mix and match dupattas and jewellery across the week.

A simple plan: tunic and jeans for Dhanteras day, an Anarkali for Dhanteras evening, a kurta set for the Diwali puja, and a pastel set for Bhai Dooj. Our [Diwali outfits](/diwali-outfits-for-women/) page brings the festive pieces together in one place.

**When is Dhanteras in 2026?**
Dhanteras is on Friday, 6 November 2026, two days before Diwali on 8 November.

**What is a good colour to wear on Dhanteras?**
Yellow, gold, red, green and royal blue are popular choices. Many women choose a colour linked with prosperity, but your own favourite works too.

**Can I wear a kurti with jeans on Dhanteras?**
Yes. A short embroidered kurti with jeans is perfect for a working day, and you can dress it up with gold jewellery for the evening puja.
